# Context7 CLI skill

Context7 is useful when coding depends on current library documentation rather than model memory. This bundle teaches the agent to resolve libraries, fetch focused docs, manage skills, and configure Context7 MCP.

The skill does not install the external CLI. A current Node.js runtime with `npx` is required; run `npx ctx7@latest <command>` without global installation, or follow the [official Context7 repository](https://github.com/upstash/context7) for current prerequisites. Authentication is optional for most documentation commands.

This installed snapshot is adapted as recorded in [provenance.json](provenance.json) and retains the upstream [MIT licence](LICENSE).
